detailed_description:
The target video uses a cinematic, live-action summer aesthetic with soft natural afternoon lighting and a warm but slightly diffused color palette that emphasizes the lush green pond, the warm wooden planks, and the soft pink and white of the lotus petals.

[Shot 1] A wide tracking shot opens on a long, narrow wooden boardwalk that runs straight through a vast lotus pond, its weathered planks in a warm honey-brown tone with dark water visible between the gaps. Dense clusters of pink and white lotus flowers in full bloom stretch to the horizon on both sides, their large round leaves forming a continuous green carpet over the water, and tall green seed pods rising among the open blooms under a clear, slightly hazy summer sky. The three young women walk side by side along the boardwalk at a relaxed, unhurried pace. <Subject 1>, the young woman with long pink hair, wearing a light sleeveless white top and a flowing pale-blue skirt, walks on the left. <Subject 2>, the young woman with long flowing dark hair, wearing a cream-colored sleeveless dress that drapes softly around her knees, walks in the center. <Subject 3>, the young woman with brown hair in a loose half-up style, wearing a white linen shirt tucked into a soft beige midi skirt, walks on the right. The camera tracks them with a smooth side-follow motion at walking speed, keeping the three subjects in the lower-middle of the frame while the wooden planks of the boardwalk recede into the foreground, and the lotus pond fills both sides of the background with a shallow depth of field that softens the distant blooms into layered pink and green washes. <Subject 1> (S1) points toward a large lotus bloom on the left and says in a bright, excited voice: <d>[Chinese] 快看那边的荷花，开得好大！</d> <Subject 2> (S2) leans in with a gentle smile and replies in a soft, warm voice: <d>[Chinese] 真的诶，我们拍张照吧？</d> <Subject 3> (S3) nods enthusiastically and says in a lively, cheerful voice: <d>[Chinese] 好啊好啊，这风吹着太舒服了。</d> A gentle breeze moves loose strands of hair on all three women as lotus leaves and reeds rustle softly, and a few scattered pink petals drift across the frame near the lens. The three continue at an unhurried pace with light smiles, their silhouettes framed against the layered rows of pink lotus blooms behind them through the end of the shot.

overall_soundscape:
Soft outdoor summer ambience with distant bird calls, the gentle rustle of lotus leaves and reeds in a light breeze, light footfalls on the wooden boardwalk, and occasional soft laughter from the women.
